info.name: CodeComrade API
info.description: Peer code review platform API. Every response, success or failure, uses the envelope shape defined in PROJECT_BLUEPRINT §3. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header whose value matches the requestId in any error body.

request.description: Confirms the process is running. Touches nothing external, so it keeps passing even when the database is down.

response.name: The process is alive.
Unexpected server error. The message is deliberately generic; the requestId maps to the full details in the logs.

request.description: Confirms the service can reach its database and serve traffic. Returns 503 when the database is unreachable.

response.name: The service is ready to serve traffic.
Unexpected server error. The message is deliberately generic; the requestId maps to the full details in the logs.
The service cannot serve traffic right now. SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when a dependency such as the database is unreachable, REQUEST_TIMEOUT when the request exceeded REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.
